answer: Reputation decays with an exponential temporal half-life, so nodes must provide sustained, verifiable honest service to retain influence; brief activity cannot build durable trust. An island of colluding nodes in the tundra cannot pass consensus without sustained transitive support from established peers, as shown in the network atlas.
